# BU N=4 positive BRC observer: certified 2D capacity extension beyond N0=0

2026-10-29 | AUTHOR_ANALYTIC_PROOF | EXTERNAL_FINITE_DUAL_PROBABILITY_MODEL | UNREVIEWED / NOT_ADMITTED

## Frozen model and actual theorem

Inherit exactly the strictly positive 16-leaf P/Q stopping tree, the observable (T,Decision,Z_BU), signed four-observation-atom reduction, and lawful randomized causal policy constraints from Enterprise Math commit 88492f07eacb063891464c536ec906e8298fcd71, research_notes/brc_n4_bu_expanded_2d_rectangle_20261029_r11/PROOF.md. The target is F=(a,b,1,0), with 0<=A,B,c<=1, 0<=U<=A, 0<=V<=B. Inherited event-TV duals L0,L3,R are hypotheses of this extension, subject to independent replication of the complete 16-leaf to four-atom causal reduction.

THEOREM (author-side conditional exact all-causal minimax). For all real a in [97/100,99/100] and b in [1/100,307/2100], the common S2 and S23 optimum d_2=d_23 has the two branches previously established only for b<=1/8:

- b<=beta(a): d=b*cstar/(4+cstar).
- b>=beta(a): d=(a+3b-1)*(7-a-21*b)/[12*(4*a+12*b+2)].

Here beta(a)=(4*a-1-sqrt(121*a^2-8*a-104))/21 and cstar is the unique root in (3/7,1) of (a+3*b)*c^2+(3*a+8*b)*c+14*b-4*a=0. They coincide at beta(a). Only the new capacity strip 1/8<=b<=307/2100 needs proving; the earlier rectangle supplies the unchanged root branch and transition.

The extension has positive area. In particular (a,b)=(97/100,13/100) has exact optimum d=33/2480 even though the former c=3/7 endpoint obstruction N0=131*a^2+576*a*b-232*a+549*b^2-1746*b+245 equals -2313/1250. Therefore N0=0 is demonstrably not the minimax capacity phase boundary.

## New all-c upper/lower match in the extra strip

Let k=7/20, D=4*a+12*b+2, ccap=(7-a-21*b)/D and ecap=ccap*(a+3*b-1)/12. The inherited observable-event total-variation duals valid for every lawful real competitor are

L0(c)=[4*a-14*b-3*a*c-(a+3*b)*c^2]/[2*(23-2*c)] <= e for c in [0,3/7],
L3(c)=c*[a-(a+3*b)*c]/[2*(7-2*c)] <= e for c in [0,1],
R(c)=c*(a+3*b-1)/12 <= e for c in [0,1],

where e=max(TV_P,TV_Q). Each is a nonnegative convex combination of observable event signed differences, using the inherited explicit weights and event list. The following exact algebraic identities hold:

L0(k)-ecap = N(a,b)/[53520*(2*a+6*b+1)],
N=9016*a^2+39396*a*b-14447*a+37044*b^2-110901*b+15610;

L3(k)-ecap = (7*a+21*b-10)*(8*a+84*b-21)/[720*(2*a+6*b+1)];

L3(ccap)=R(ccap)=ecap.

For all a in [97/100,99/100], b in [1/8,307/2100], N_a=18032*a+39396*b-14447>0 and N_b=39396*a+74088*b-110901<0. Thus N>=N(97/100,307/2100)>0; equivalently L0(k)-ecap>=89369/74482000>0. The two linear factors of L3(k)-ecap are both nonpositive, since their maximum values, reached at (99/100,307/2100), are respectively 0 and -4/5. So L3(k)>=ecap.

The partials of ccap are (72*b-30)/D^2<0 and -(72*a+126)/D^2<0. Hence 343/900=ccap(99/100,307/2100)<=ccap<1, and k=7/20<343/900. The inherited derivative identities show L0 decreases on [0,3/7] and L3 has at most one internal maximum, hence no internal minimum on any [k,ccap]. Since a+3*b-1>0, R is increasing. Split any lawful common c:

0<=c<=k: e>=L0(c)>=L0(k)>=ecap.
k<=c<=ccap: e>=L3(c)>=min(L3(k),L3(ccap))>=ecap.
ccap<=c<=1: e>=R(c)>=R(ccap)=ecap.

For attainment choose the real causal randomized policy
A=1, B=(a+3*b-1)/3, c=ccap, U=B*(1+c), V=B.
It is feasible since 0<B<=b<=307/2100 and U<=2*b<1=A. The exact inherited signed observation atoms become
Delta_Q=((1-a)/3, ecap-(1-a)/3, 0, -ecap),
Delta_P=(0,0,ecap,-ecap).

The second Q entry is nonnegative because
ecap-(1-a)/3=G/[8*(2*a+6*b+1)],
G=5*a^2+8*a*b-21*b^2-2*b-5.
On the whole strip G_a=10*a+8*b>0, G_bb=-42<0. Therefore the minimum is at a=97/100 and one of the two b endpoints; G(97/100,1/8)=771/8000>0, G(97/100,307/2100)=1283/13125>0. Both TV norms are thus exactly ecap, matching the all-real causal lower bound. Glue to the already-proved b<=1/8 theorem to conclude the two-branch rectangle.

## Exact failure witness for former N0 certificate

At a=97/100,b=13/100: ccap=55/124, ecap=33/2480 and N0=-2313/1250. The old N0 condition fails while the new k=7/20 observable-event dual certificate and the lawful capacity strategy agree at ecap. This is an exact counterexample to treating N0=0 as an actual capacity-optimality boundary, NOT a counterexample to capacity optimality or a claim about physical X6 residuals.

## Verification, dependencies, next issue

The accompanying VERIFY.py actually ran locally with SymPy and printed PASS_EXACT_BU_N4_EXTENDED_CAPACITY_2D_20261029. It asserts both symbolic dual-gap identities, ccap/R/G identities, rational endpoint and derivative inequalities, the N0 obstruction point, and full signed four-observation-atom TVs of three exact rational capacity policies. Universal quantification follows from the displayed inequalities and inherited event-TV certificates, not finite testing. This is algebraic verification inside the external positive BRC probability abstraction, not a native typed BRC heartbeat computation. The 16-leaf P/Q tree and all-causal reduction were inherited; their independent rederivation, Source-native CLAIM/Result/Driver review, and the P000 X6/three-dimensional-slice/time observer bridge remain separate verification tasks.

Next: for b>307/2100 seek adaptive stitch k(a,b) in [0,3/7], maintaining L0(k),L3(k)>=ecap, or construct a lawful rational strategy with e<ecap. Test a=99/100,b=3/20 first.
